source_document: VERGE_self_play_revised.pdf Appendix C/D p10: same temporary branch count and same selector, target-only training

branch_training_randomness: Distinct fixed branch-labelled streams within one training seed42; no independent training-repeat or seed scan
endpoint_randomness: Shared round-specific aligned instance/draw streams across all four endpoints and round start
selector: Same endpoint-only positive paired-interval and observed scope gates, softmax candidates plus safe references; coincident zero-update direct/start counted once; reference ties retain start
